{{Quote|To extract the module, you'll need to be able to override the droideka's security protocol. Otherwise the module will burn itself out when you endeavor to remove it.|[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Zanier Hudmasse]]|<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Legacy|Old Republic Droid Modules: The Droideka|Naboo}}</ref>}}
A '''security beacon''' was a type of technology used to bypass security systems. This kind of device typically needed a [[sequencer]] to be functional with specific security systems. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a spacer used a security beacon to retrieve an experimental [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] module from a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] studied at [[Stonewall Labs]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" />
